rating.comments: Student-authored messages are 'yes', 'yes', 'the teenagers can learn things whit the social media', 'no', 'no', 'yes'. Only one message gives a substantive claim (social media helps teenagers learn), stated without reason, so reasoning is 1 (no justification) rather than 2 under the bare-claim anchor only if no step is shown; the single claim is a stated point with no reason, and it is the only task-focused content. Knowledge building is 1 because the student does not use or extend the tutor's points, and the 'yes' and 'no' replies only repeat or echo. No questions were asked. Effort is 2 because replies are one-word or fragmentary with no complete attempt at forming an opinion.
